notes: Pat wings completely dry before seasoning. No salt with the baking powder initially - salt draws out moisture. Toss wings with buffalo sauce immediately while screaming hot so it partially cooks onto the skin.

steps: Pat wings completely dry with paper towels.
Season wings with baking powder (no salt yet) and let sit to draw out moisture.
Cook wings for 25-30 minutes, flipping once halfway through.
While wings cook, melt butter and mix with Crystal Hot Sauce.
Immediately toss screaming hot wings with buffalo sauce so it partially cooks onto the skin.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
recipe.serving: Serve immediately while hot and crispy
recipe.storage: Best eaten fresh, but leftovers can be reheated in air fryer for 2-3 minutes
